insights.title: 1 key page has no main heading
insights.detail: A clear main heading helps visitors and is one of the sources Google uses for the title it shows.
insights.action: Give each page one prominent heading that says what the page is about.

insights.title: Google can't read business details (Organization or LocalBusiness) on the homepage
insights.detail: This markup gives Google the business name, logo and contact details in a standard format. It helps how the business is shown, not where it ranks.
insights.action: Add Organization (or LocalBusiness) markup with name, logo, phone, address and social profiles.

insights.title: 1 key page has very little text
insights.detail: Google has no word-count target and short pages can be fine. But a page with little text may not answer what an owner or renter came to find out.
insights.action: Check each page answers the main questions (fees, areas served, how it works). Don't pad it.

insights.detail: Ranking swings around an update are normal and often settle after it ends. Search Console drops that overlap an update are marked as such and kept at low priority.

insights.title: The homepage is live at 3 addresses
insights.detail: / and /index.html and /Website-Portfolio/ show the same content. This isn't a penalty: Google picks one version to show. But it has to guess, and links and Search Console data can be split between the addresses.
insights.action: 301-redirect the copies to / (best), or point their canonical tag at it. Delete leftover test copies.

insights.title: The homepage's main address isn't in the sitemap
insights.detail: The sitemap doesn't list /. Google will still find the homepage, but the sitemap should list the address you want shown.
insights.action: List the homepage as / in the sitemap (and not /index).
